prompt: A histogram groups data into bins. If bin $0-9$ has $4$ values and bin $10-19$ has $7$ values, which bin has more?
hint: Each bin of a histogram has a count, and a higher count means a taller bar.

hints.text: Each bin of a histogram has a count, and a higher count means a taller bar.
The bin $0$-$9$ holds $4$ values and the bin $10$-$19$ holds $7$ values. Compare the numbers $4$ and $7$.
Since $7 > 4$, the bin $10$-$19$ has more values.

explanation: A histogram sorts the data into bins and records how many values land in each bin.
Here the bin $0$-$9$ has $4$ values and the bin $10$-$19$ has $7$ values.
Because $7$ is greater than $4$, the bin $10$-$19$ has more values.
